data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English adel (noble) and ric (ruler). The name Adelric was common among Anglo-Saxon and Germanic rulers. In the Middle Ages, it was adopted by the French nobility. The name Adelric carries the meaning “Noble ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adelric usually hope their child will grow to embody noble ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
